title: Permanently delete workspace
scope: This permanently removes this folder, its records, history, drafts, original evidence, website designs, local settings and workspace access grants. It does not use the Recycle Bin.
database-workspace: The workspace's dedicated PostgreSQL database will also be removed.
database-catalogue: Only this workspace's catalogue will be removed from the shared database. Other workspaces will remain.
database-files: All files belonging to this workspace will be removed.
retained: Separate copies and backups, downloaded exports and already published websites remain. Your Observanda identity and GitHub account remain available to your other workspaces.
name: Type the workspace name to confirm
confirm: I understand that the workspace and its data will be permanently deleted.
pendingHint: Deletion has already been authorized. Finish removing the remaining data. A new workspace created at the original location will not be deleted.
credentials: If this workspace uses a password or recovery key, enter it to finish stopping its database. An authorized device can continue without a password.
cancelled: Deletion had not started. The workspace is unchanged.
retryHint: The operation did not finish. Open Workspaces to review any unfinished deletion.
waiting: Stopping the database and removing its catalogue. File deletion follows automatically.
authenticate: Unlock this workspace to review its deletion.
